items.title: How total capacity grows as you add servers — until a shared bottleneck caps it
items.description: TicketRush's single server maxed out around 500 requests/sec. Adding identical servers behind a load balancer should multiply that — but only up to whatever a shared resource (here, the database) can actually sustain. Drag 'Servers' up to see capacity grow roughly linearly at first, then flatten hard once the shared bottleneck becomes the limit instead of any one server.
items.compute: const raw = params.numServers * params.perServerCapacity; const totalCapacity = Math.min(raw, params.sharedBottleneckCapacity); return { totalCapacity };
